recorded.how: scripts/server-bench/run.ts, one fresh playground per run, identical counts in all three runs apart from one diff scope in the app profile (14 or 15); measured on the step 5a working tree, whose commit follows 5331f6ea
recorded.note: Ceilings are measured current cost with headroom, not targets. A change list is 6: working files are digested from the filesystem rather than hashed by Git, so no filename can break it. A diff request is 7 rather than 6 because it reads the status on both sides of the hunks — once to check the request against, once to bind the hunks to the fingerprints returned with them. Marking is still one request per file and each one re-reads the list to refuse a stale fingerprint; 'mark all' being one request is section 4's to collect. History is untouched until step 5c.
